Terms of Use — Draft for legal review

Not legally approved; operator must complete terms, refund/cancellation policy, governing law and support contact before any live subscriptions.

Beta service

RationWise estimates least-cost blends based on user-provided values. Calculations may be mathematically feasible but nutritionally incomplete; outputs are not certified diets, veterinary recommendations or animal feeding instructions. Consult a qualified animal nutritionist and follow local animal-feed law before manufacturing or feeding.

Accounts

Customers are responsible for protecting account credentials and lawful use of uploaded data. Data accuracy and rights clearance remain their responsibility.

Billing

Paid plans, if activated, are processed by Stripe. Checkout shows final prices and applicable taxes; recurring charges continue until canceled subject to the final published terms. This draft does not describe a finalized refund or tax policy.

Rights and limitations

No third-party feed-composition datasets are included without appropriate rights; users must have permission to upload data. Service availability, liability limits and legal terms require counsel review.
